summary: kepler@5.999.999 fetches and executes tarball from non-registry host on install
details: The package's index.js only exports a name/version string and has no library functionality. Its sole effect on install is declaring a dependency `flag-serial-object-syntax` resolved via a hardcoded direct URL to `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/flag-serial-object-syntax` (not the npm registry). The shrinkwrap pins the same off-registry URL and marks `hasInstallScript: true`, so `npm install` downloads that tarball from a third-party host and runs its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The version number 5.999.999 is a dependency-confusion overshadow shape, intended to outrank an internal package of the same name during resolution. The installer receives and executes arbitrary code controlled by whoever operates artifacts.yosiroute.com.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
